meta.note: All extraction from server/cfg/*.json (deconstructed 1.4.11) + analysis/1.4.9/task/config_mon.json (1.4.9 reference). No server/ code modified.

config_mon_data_luac_1_4_11.detail: Luac contains 13267 TableConst entries (monster definitions) + 7956 numeric keys (IDs), but the standard deconstruct script only extracted the Filter sub-table (3 entries). The Mon and MonData main tables came out empty ({}).
config_mon_data_luac_1_4_11.evidence: CONFIRMED - _mon_dis.txt disassembly shows TableConst array data matching the 24-element monster format.

config_mon_json_1_4_9.note: 1.4.9 extraction succeeded with 2645 monsters. Same 24-element array format as 1.4.11 luac. This is our reference dataset.

20.desc: special attack effect ID (5 unique values)

monster_combat_stats_verdict.reason: Monster config table stores ONLY metadata (name, level, type, resource, AI, scale factor, drop tier). Actual combat stats (HP, ATK, DEF, EXP, coins) are NOT stored per-monster in config. They are computed server-side via formula: base_stats(level) * type_multiplier * scale_factor[field_21]. The formula itself is in server code (likely mock_server.py battle module), NOT in config tables.
monster_combat_stats_verdict.evidence: CONFIRMED - 2645 monsters across all level bands show identical field[14] values (170) and no per-monster HP/ATK fields. If HP were stored, it would vary by level.
monster_combat_stats_verdict.conclusion: 1.4.11 怪物数值表无显式战斗数值字段。怪物 HP/ATK/DEF/EXP 均由服务端公式基于 level + type + scale_factor 计算。配置真值 UNKNOWN，需真服抓包或反编译服务端战斗模块获取公式。

boss_config.note: Boss config only has metadata (name, level, map, drop list). No explicit combat stats. Boss HP/ATK computed via same server-side formula with elite multiplier.

demon_config.star_info_detail: Per-star level action_power (50/60/70/80/90) + skill lists. This is a PVE tower/arena mechanic, not standard monster combat stats.

attr_power_table.description: Power score conversion coefficients: 1 point of each attribute = this many power points.
attr_power_table.evidence: CONFIRMED (table exists and values are read from config)
attr_power_table.note: These are战力换算系数, not damage formula coefficients. The actual damage formula (ATK vs DEF → damage) coefficients are NOT in config.

fight_type_enum.note: Just an enum, not formula constants.

damage_formula_coefficients.reason: No config table contains damage formula coefficients (e.g., base_damage = ATK * k - DEF * k2, crit_multiplier, etc.). These are hardcoded in server battle logic.
damage_formula_coefficients.evidence: UNKNOWN - needs server-side decompilation or live packet capture.

exp_table.note: This is the player exp/level table (not monster exp). Confirms exp_max values per level.
exp_table.verification_note: Task mentioned exp_max=2600094@lv70. Actual config value = 2,577,419. Close but not exact - likely the 2600094 figure was from a different version or approximation.

equipment_base_stats.reason: config_item.json ItemData entries (32-element arrays) do NOT contain base equipment attribute values (no atk/def/hp fields in the array). The item array has type, name, quality, level requirement, price, etc., but no stat block.

intensify_table.all_reward: IntensifyAllReward: cumulative set bonus at thresholds 6-8+
intensify_table.note: Intensify bonus values ARE in config (e.g., +8 weapon = atk_s+20, atk_p+20). But the BASE equipment stats (before any intensify) are NOT in the item table. They must come from a separate equipment level/type table or be computed from equipment level.

base_equipment_stats.note: Base equipment stats (what a +0 weapon of level X gives) are NOT found in any config table we've examined. Likely computed from equipment level + type via a formula, or stored in a table we haven't identified.
base_equipment_stats.evidence: UNKNOWN - needs MuMu runtime capture or further config archaeology.
